channel.title: JustJayDev — Devlog
channel.description: Build log of a self-taught mobile developer from India. What I am working on, what broke, what shipped.

item.title: v6 — official game art + real profile
item.description: Two upgrades. First the art: every game banner is now the official Google Play feature graphic for that game — real, current, high-quality artwork instead of AI-generated placeholders. All nine images were verified, converted to webp, and are serving live. Second the profile: re-collected everything from scratch — a new tagline, a fresh bio, sharper interest tags, all six social links wired in (GitHub, YouTube, Instagram, Threads, Discord, Reddit), the real device specs pulled straight from the phone, and a clubs section for the teams I support. Private details stay private and are only visible in the password-protected secret area.

item.title: v1 — the alt site is live: Neon Cyber Terminal edition
item.description: The new main site — a full rebuild in a Neon Cyber Terminal design. This one runs a Neon Cyber Terminal design: dark glassmorphism panels, neon glow palette, a fixed grid backdrop with drifting glow orbs and scanlines, a glitch-slice hero title, typewriter caret, ripple buttons, an infinite ticker, animated stat counters, a horizontal scroll-snap game showcase (instead of the main site's grid), a casual-classics marquee, terminal-style about blocks, a timeline devlog, and a glitch 404. Same 19 games, same profile, same RSS feed — just rebuilt the way I wanted it to look. Every effect respects prefers-reduced-motion and touch devices skip the pointer effects.

item.title: v5 — cinematic motion system + Roblox art fixed
item.description: Two things. First the bug: the Roblox banner never loaded because the file was SVG content saved with a .png extension — GitHub served it as image/png so browsers refused to render it. Renamed to .svg and it renders now. Second the overhaul: replaced the flat animations with a proper cinematic system — layered parallax orbs that drift with the pointer, a breathing glow on the avatar, poster-card sheen sweeps with corner brackets, a glow that follows the cursor across each game card, staggered spring pops on achievement badges, ripple feedback on every button, a gradient scroll-progress bar, and the casual classics strip is now an infinite marquee. Every effect respects prefers-reduced-motion and touch devices skip the pointer effects.

item.title: v4.1 — game cards that don't crop your logos
item.description: Fixed the Games page banners. Every game art is a different shape, so the old fixed-height crop was cutting logos in half. Banners are now aspect-ratio safe with object-fit: contain, a subtle scanline texture, and a slow hover zoom that scales without re-cropping. Achievement chips got an animated shine sweep. Among Us art was portrait (0.67 ratio) — it letterboxes cleanly now instead of showing a sliver.

item.title: v4 — the revamp: command palette, achievements, cinematic hero
item.description: Big visual revamp. Hero got an animated mesh-gradient backdrop and a character-by-character title reveal. Added a command palette (Cmd/Ctrl+K) for jumping anywhere, a visitor achievement system with 5 unlockable badges that persist in localStorage, a spotlight glow that follows the cursor on desktop, magnetic hero buttons, a live now-playing ticker, and scroll-triggered section reveals. Also deleted 157 lines of dead arcade/mini-games CSS that nothing used.

item.title: v3.9 — dead code cleanup + verified stats
item.description: Cleanup pass: removed the unused Guestbook component, 5 dead CSS classes, and fixed a missing button-shine class that About page relied on. Clash Royale and Brawl Stars cards now show real trophy counts and rank badges with a verified flag and last-updated date. The 3D tilt on game cards actually works now — it was defined in CSS but nothing was driving it.

item.title: v3.1 → v3.3 — the overnight polish sprint
item.description: Big polish pass: scroll progress bar, back-to-top button, typewriter taglines, a stats strip, live search on the Games page, copy-link buttons on every devlog entry, per-page titles, a custom 404 page, and a keyboard focus ring. Three builds, one night.

item.title: Site v3 — the lean rebuild
item.description: Rebuilt the whole site lean: 3 focused pages (Home, Games, About), every page lazy-loaded, Firebase and 13 unused pages removed. Same URL, same QR, way faster.

item.title: One repo to rule them all
item.description: Deleted 4 old repos and renamed this one to JustJayDev.github.io — the site now lives at the ROOT: justjaydev.github.io. Every path config migrated in one pass, QR still works, Google Search Console verification planted.

item.title: New hero: the motto wall
item.description: Added my motto wallpaper as the homepage hero — "A King Never Wavers", Code. Build. Improve. Repeat., Focus. Discipline. Freedom. Also the new OG share image and the PWA app icon.

item.title: Made every page load lazy
item.description: All 16 pages used to load in one big JavaScript bundle. Now every page is code-split with React.lazy — the browser only downloads the page you actually open. First paint feels snappier on slow data.

item.title: New Details page — everything in one place
item.description: Added a Details page: one page with all my info, setup, skills, projects, a timeline, and an FAQ. It runs on a single data file.

item.title: Site v2 is live — and the QR works
item.description: Rebuilt the whole site: PWA offline support, animated stats, glare-tilt cards, magnetic buttons, a glitch 404, and a footer with a real scannable QR code that opens this site.

item.title: justjaydev.github.io — this site is now my main home
item.description: Promoted this site to my main GitHub Pages home: the URL is now just justjaydev.github.io (no subfolder), old project repos are retired, and this is where everything new will ship first.
